deploy-bot: ALERT: pipeline 'main' turned red after merge by @Olivia — job: packager-smoke (run/35678). logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/35678 :rotating_light:
Maya: who owns packager-smoke? pinging @Sam @Aj
Sam: I can grab this, putting on my TODO list now. which step is failing?
deploy-bot: failing step: artifact-fetch -> exit 1. sample log:
```
ERROR: download failed: HTTP 500 from artifacts.redwood.internal/local/pack-35678.tar.gz
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/fetch_artifact", line 42, in <module>
    resp = s.get(url, timeout=30)
  File "requests/api.py", line 75, in get
    raise HTTPError('500 Server Error')
HTTPError: 500 Server Error
```
Sam: hm 500 from artifact service. could be transient upstream or our artifact proxy. i'm going to attempt a rerun of the failing job: `cictl rerun-job --id 35678`
Aj: noted there was a storage maintenance alert ~10m ago in infra-monitor, might be related. also saw NFS latency spikes ~15m ago.
Sam: rerun kicked off (job 35679). waiting for result...
Sam: rerun still failing, same 500 on download. reproducing locally with `curl -v` gives 502 intermittently.
Maya: Olivia — did the merge touch packaging CI or artifact paths?
Olivia: I merged #9876 (commit 8f3d2b4) — just a docs fix, did not touch build infra. here's the merge commit: https://git.redwood.dev/r/9876/commits/8f3d2b4
Ryan: i'll start a quick bisect between the last green (run 35650) and this run. if it's storage flakiness we can revert the merge but prefer to avoid unless needed.
Sam: workaround suggestion: force artifacts to fallback bucket by setting env `ARTIFACT_FALLBACK=true` in packager job. quick patch attached: `ci/overrides/packager-fallback.yml`
Aj: good call — if fallback is enabled it should avoid the proxy that returned 500s. can someone try a one-off with fallback?
Sam: triggered a one-off with fallback (run 35680).
Sam: good news — run 35680 passed artifact-fetch, but a downstream step (integration-smoke) failed on flake unrelated to artifacts.
Maya: so root cause likely storage flakiness; packager can fall back. can we keep fallback enabled for the next few deploys and open a ticket to infra?
Olivia: +1. i'll file infra ticket and cc storage-team.
Ryan: i'll capture the bisect artifacts but since fallback fixes packaging, let's not revert the docs merge.
Sam: taking ownership this incident. i'll patch prod pipeline to set fallback for the next 6 hours and follow up with postmortem if infra confirms degraded storage. will update the thread with ticket number. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: RUN 35680 (one-off with fallback) — all steps green.
Maya: thanks Sam — add note to incident-runbook and mark as mitigated for now.
Sam: filed ticket STORAGE-442 (infra), linking logs and proxy traces. will keep monitoring and update when fixed.
